name: American Justice
description: Hosted by Bill Kurtis, American Justice looks at groundbreaking criminal cases, presenting viewers with an inside look at the case through the eyes of those directly involved, ranging from law enforcement officers to the victims.

videos.title: The Kennedys and the Mob
videos.overview: The 1978 mass suicide of followers of Rev. Jim Jones, a cult leader who founded Jonestown in Guyana for the work of his People's Temple. Also: the murder of Rep. Leo J. Ryan, who was investigating allegations made by temple members.

videos.title: Boston Strangler
videos.overview: The police investigation of "The Boston Strangler," who murdered 13 women from 1962 to 1964. Included: techniques such as psychic consultation and hypnosis.

videos.title: Murph the Surf
videos.overview: Profiling Jack Murphy, a.k.a. "Murph the Surf," who was convicted of stealing the Star of India sapphire and other precious gems from New York's American Museum of Natural History in 1964.

videos.title: The Hillside Stranglers
videos.overview: Profiling the case of two American serial killers who terrorized Los Angeles between October 1977 and February 1978, with their nicknames originating from the fact that many of the victims' bodies were discovered on the sides of the Hollywood Hills.

videos.title: Ted Bundy
videos.overview: Profiling the case of Ted Bundy, who was executed in 1989 for several murders and who was suspected of killing 25 women in six states.

videos.title: John Wayne Gacy
videos.overview: Profiling the case of John Wayne Gacy Jr., who was convicted in 1980 of murdering 33 young men and boys and who was executed by the state of Illinois in 1994.

videos.title: Dr. Jeffrey MacDonald: The Green Beret Killer
videos.overview: Examining the case in which a man's wife and children were brutally murdered, he claimed, by drug-crazed hippies.

videos.title: The Trial of Adolf Eichmann
videos.overview: Adolf Eichmann, the Nazi official captured by Israeli agents in 1960 and taken to Israel to be tried for war crimes.

videos.title: City Killer Gangs
videos.overview: Organized crime during the Prohibition era, including profiles of Al Capone, Bugs Moran and Lucky Luciano. Brooklyn DA Charles J. Hynes joins host Bill Kurtis.

videos.title: Jean Harris
videos.overview: The case of Jean Harris, the former headmistress convicted of murdering her lover, Dr. Herman Tarnower, in 1980.

videos.title: Howard Hughes Biography Hoax
videos.overview: Recalling a hoax in the 1970s involving an alleged authorized biography of Howard Hughes by Clifford Irving.

videos.title: Charles Starkweather
videos.overview: Charles Starkweather, executed in 1959 for committing 11 murders.

videos.title: Richard Speck
videos.overview: The case of Richard Speck, who was convicted of the 1966 murders of eight nurses and student nurses in Chicago.

videos.title: Wayne Williams
videos.overview: Wayne Williams, convicted of two of the Atlanta child murders that terrorized the city between 1979 and 1981.

videos.title: Mafia Wars
videos.overview: Examining the battles waged against gangland families by the Gambino organized-crime family, led by "Boss of Bosses" Paul Castellano, until his 1985 assassination that was masterminded by John Gotti.

videos.title: Bonnie and Clyde
videos.overview: Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow, whose string of robberies and killings made them two of the most notorious criminals of the 1930s.

videos.title: Target: Mafia (The Prohibition Years)
videos.overview: Profiling crime during Prohibition. Examining Assistant Attorney General Mabel Walker Willebrandt's efforts to curtail bootlegging; battles between ethnic gangs.

videos.title: Target: Mafia (Birth of the American Mafia)
videos.overview: Examining  the birth of the American mafia from its origins in Sicily to mob activity during Prohibition. Included: the roles of Al Capone and Charles "Lucky" Luciano; rivalry among Italian, Irish and Jewish gangs.

videos.title: Target: Mafia (The Kennedys and the Mob)
videos.overview: Examining efforts by President Kennedy and his brother Robert to curtail mob activity; the possible link between JFK's assassination and organized crime.

videos.title: Target: Mafia (Gangbusters)
videos.overview: Profiling "gangbusters" such as Harry Anslinger, first commissioner of the Bureau of Narcotics; and Thomas E. Dewey, who successfully prosecuted Charles "Lucky" Luciano on charges of running a prostitution ring.

videos.title: Target: Mafia (Empire of Crime)
videos.overview: Examining mob activity during World War II; the murder of Benjamin Siegel; nightclubs, casinos and racetracks linked to organized crime.

videos.title: Mobfathers, Part 1
videos.overview: A three-part history of mob activity in Philadelphia. [Part 1 of 3] shows how Nicodemo Scarfo gained power by supplying concrete to the growing casino industry in Atlantic City.

videos.title: Mobfathers, Part 2
videos.overview: Part 2 of a three-part history of mob activity in Philadelphia. [Part 2 of 3] concerns local and Federal government investigations of Nicodemo Scarfo, which led to his imprisonment. Included: Scarfo's operations —from Philadelphia to Florida.

videos.title: Mobfathers, Part 3
videos.overview: Part 3 of a three-part history of mob activity in Philadelphia. [Part 3 of 3] examines connections between the Sicilian Mafia and the U.S., and the influence of the incarcerated Nicodemo Scarfo on crime in Philadelphia.

videos.title: Rape on Trial
videos.overview: Examining highly publicized rape cases, including the 1992 conviction of Mike Tyson for the rape of a beauty-pageant contestant; and the 1983 gang-rape case in New Bedford, Mass., that inspired the 1988 movie "The Accused."

videos.title: Dahmer: Mystery of a Serial Killer
videos.overview: A graphic account of the crimes of serial killer Jeffrey Dahmer who became, his attorney Gerald Boyle says, "the embodiment of evil." Included: footage from Dahmer's trial; comments from experts on serial murder.

videos.title: The Rosenbergs
videos.overview: Back to the 1950's and an era of the "Red Scare" to examine the evidence against Julius and Ethel Rosenberg that led to their conviction of espionage and ultimately both of their executions in 1953.

videos.title: Fire Starters
videos.overview: Examining two arson cases: the 1990 blaze at the Happy Land club in the Bronx, which claimed 87 lives; and the 1944 Hartford Circus fire, in which 168 people were killed. Included: retired firefighter Rick Davey, who investigated the Hartford fire.

videos.title: Alcatraz: Escaping America's Toughest Prison
videos.overview: A history of Alcatraz recalls some of the prison's most spectacular breakout attempts, including one that inspired the film "Escape from Alcatraz." Included: the maximum-security prison at Marion, Ill.

videos.title: KKK: Hate Crimes in America
videos.overview: Racially motivated crimes in the U.S., such as the murders of three civil-rights workers in Mississippi, and the 1988 beating death of an Ethiopian student in Oregon. Included: comments from attorney Morris Dees.

videos.title: Vigilante Justice
videos.overview: Cases of vigilantism in the U.S., including the 1984 Bernhard Goetz subway shooting in New York City; the 1984 murder of an alleged child molester; and the 1987 torching of a Detroit crack house.

videos.title: The Showdown
videos.overview: From the mid to late 70's and throughout the 80's America's war on crime takes a toll on the Mafia. American Justice takes a look at some mob figures and leaders during those years and some of the events that led to their downfall, death, or incarceration.

videos.title: Target: Mafia: Secrets Unveiled
videos.overview: Crime summit at Apalachin; Castellano seizes Gambino's power.

videos.title: Mass Murder: An American Tragedy
videos.overview: Charles Whitman kills his mother and wife, then fires from a University of Texas tower.

videos.title: The Hostage Takers
videos.overview: Prominent cases show how police deal with hostage situations.

videos.title: The Wrong Man
videos.overview: Profiles of people who have been falsely accused and imprisoned.

videos.title: Great Heists
videos.overview: In 1950 the Brinks robbery nets $2.8

videos.title: Fugitives
videos.overview: How the American legal system deals with fugitives, focusing on John List, a killer who eluded the FBI for more than a decade.

videos.title: Death Penalty
videos.overview: Capital punishment; Caryl Chessman; Gary Gilmore; Sister Helen Prejean ministers to death-row inmates.

videos.title: Juvenile Justice
videos.overview: Youthful offenders; teens shoot British tourist.

videos.title: Mob Rats
videos.overview: Joseph Valachi and Peter Maas are featured in this look at mobsters who turn against fellow criminals and help law enforcement agencies convict them.

videos.title: War Crimes
videos.overview: Nuremberg, My Lai and other war-crime trials.

videos.title: Satan, Rituals and Abuse
videos.overview: Cases of psychological manipulation.

videos.title: Lorena Bobbitt: Women and Violence
videos.overview: Increasing violence in society; battered women.

videos.title: Prison Justice
videos.overview: Violence and behavior codes in America's prisons.

videos.title: Pleading Insane
videos.overview: John Hinckley Jr.; Daniel Sickles kills Francis Scott Key's son; the McNaughton rule; Kimberly Martin.

videos.title: Cops on Trial
videos.overview: Frank Serpico and Robert Leuci uncover corruption in the New York Police Department.

videos.title: Fighting Words: The First Amendment
videos.overview: The Supreme Court broadly defines free speech; Nazis march in Skokie, Ill.

videos.title: Jim Bakker: Crime in the Name of God
videos.overview: Con artists who use religion for gain.

videos.title: The Great Brink's Heist
videos.overview: In one of the most daring robberies in history, the 1950 Brink's robbery netted thieves more than $2.7 million.

videos.title: Reginald Denny: Jury Under Siege
videos.overview: Media pressure, fear and prejudice may affect jury decisions.

videos.title: Attack at Waco
videos.overview: How the authorities may have misjudged David Koresh and the situation at the Branch Davidian compound in Waco, Texas.

videos.title: Sex, Lies and Harassment
videos.overview: The Anita Hill/Clarence Thomas case brings sexual-harassment issues under scrutiny.

videos.title: Gangbusters
videos.overview: New York gang moves into Boston; Iowa street gang is implicated in a murder.

videos.title: The Attica Riot: Chaos Behind Bars
videos.overview: Prison uprisings; 1971 Attica riot; New Mexico State Penitentiary.

videos.title: Private Eyes
videos.overview: Private investigators are the cowboys of law enforcement.

videos.title: Prostitution: Sex and the Law
videos.overview: Profiling the lives of street-corner hookers and high-class Hollywood call girls and examining how they are brought to justice.

videos.title: The Sting
videos.overview: Sting operations; Marion Barry; John DeLorean.

videos.title: Riot: The Chicago Conspiracy Trial
videos.overview: Events leading up to Chicago's 1968 anti-war riots; the "conspiracy to commit riot" trials.

videos.title: Divorce Wars
videos.overview: An examination of the evolution of divorce in the United States.

videos.title: The Quiz-Show Scandals and Other Frauds
videos.overview: Quiz-show scandals of the '50s; Clifford Irving's "biography" of Howard Hughes; Tawana Brawley.

videos.title: Kidnapped
videos.overview: The abductions of biathlete Kari Swenson and Exxon executive Sidney Reso are used to explore how law enforcement agencies respond to kidnappings.

videos.title: Godfathers vs. the Law
videos.overview: The FBI adapts methods to catch racketeers; "most-wanted" list; wiretapping.

videos.title: Celebrities on Trial
videos.overview: Celebrity and equal justice; director John Landis; James Brown; Zsa Zsa Gabor; Christian Brando..

videos.title: Spies: Betraying a Nation

videos.title: Defending the Mob
videos.overview: Frank Ragano defends Santo Trafficante, Jimmy Hoffa; Bruce Cutler defends John Gotti.

videos.title: Witness Protection

videos.title: Bad Medicine

videos.title: Mob Ladies

videos.overview: The cases of John Lennon, Theresa Saldana and others illustrate the seriousness of stalking, which was not recognized as a crime until

videos.overview: A review of controversial cases raises questions about citizens or suspects dying at the hands of law enforcement officials.

videos.title: Why O.J. Simpson Won
videos.overview: A play-by-play chronicle and legal dissection of the O.J. Simpson case and its impact on the judicial system.

videos.overview: Recalling the Bamber family murder case, considered by some to be almost the perfect crime.

videos.title: The Menendez Murders
videos.overview: Three juries consider the murder cases against Erik and Lyle Menendez.

videos.overview: The murders of six prostitutes end with a man's suicide.

videos.overview: Confessions play a part in three unique criminal cases; coercion; admissibility.

videos.overview: After James Hanratty is hanged for a murder, a man confesses to the crime.

videos.overview: Profiling the lives of men and women who choose to work as homicide detectives.

The undercover operation became the subject of a 1997 feature film starring Johnny Depp and Al Pacino. Pistone discusses the operation, various mobsters and the strain on his family.

videos.title: Outlaws

videos.title: High Crimes and Misdemeanors

videos.title: The Perfect Murder: The Shannon Mohr Story
videos.overview: The marriage of David Davis and Shannon Mohr comes to an abrupt end when Shannon is killed in what was believed to have been a horseback-riding accident.
